status: Proposed fitting strategy; no248 model or new preview authored
scope: Relax rear nape drape and author coherent pashmina/long-hair fits while preserving accepted front crossing
findings: Current viewer selects one pashmina cloth fit per build/top regardless of hairstyle.
Covered hair components still originate in235/236. Those fits use per-vertex radial projection into older cloth envelopes.
Fresh enlarged profile/rear/rear-quarter views of six existing looks show a tight rear gather, abrupt hair emergence and angular/stretched upper portions of visible locks.
Previous247 all-angle review failed to reject these inherited hair/cloth fit problems. Mesh closure and retained-input hashes did not establish joint artistic fit.

recommendation.rear_drape: Add a shallow, continuous reserve of cloth over the nape and upper shoulders; preserve tension toward accepted front crossing. Avoid a tight neck ring or a large free rear cape.
recommendation.hair_exit: Use a relaxed natural lower hood edge with continuous overlap and modest lift where hair emerges. Avoid punched holes, transparent masks or locks passing through cloth.
families: Bulky curls, braids or gathered hair
recommendation.hair_authoring: Each style gets an authored covered arrangement and individual fit review. Preserve uncovered styles; shape whole locks/bundles with continuous tangents rather than pointwise pushing into cloth. Hide only genuinely concealed crown volume. Share compatible cloth drapes.

routing.loose_lengths: Emerge gradually below the rear/lateral lower edge; keep existing front/back hairstyle distribution and broad flow.
routing.braids_locs: Preserve strand/bundle identity, diameter and natural bends; route under the edge and settle on shoulders without a jagged ring of exits.
routing.ponytail: Use a believable low, hood-specific gather if the tail is exposed. Covered high roots remain inside the hood; no cap-style rear hole or protrusion through cloth.
routing.voluminous_hair: Use a modestly fuller cloth envelope that bridges curl valleys rather than tracing every curl.

next_slice: Lock247 accepted front crossing/joins, face, body, wardrobe, palettes, coordinates and materials.
Author the relaxed rear cloth first against compact hair, preserving front geometry.
Prove joint fitting with Straight, Curls, Box braids and Ponytail plus a masculine short-hair control; include masculine Locs when assigning every style.
Review source and freshly reopened exports in enlarged rear/rear-quarter/both-side/underside views, then normal body and small portrait framing. Iterate both hair and cloth together.
Assign and individually review all16 covered styles using shared drape families where they actually fit; retain per-top garment support and test hoodie/jersey/light-top boundaries.
Publish selectable matched comparisons only once the representative arrangements pass; then update the rendering handoff and rebake matching color/depth outputs.
acceptance: No visible hair penetration in cloth-covered regions. Hair emerges only at intentional open boundaries with convincing overlap and shadow.
Visible locks retain thickness, curvature, texture and coherent roots without radial projection kinks or chopped collars.
Rear cloth has modest slack and shoulder support without neck pinching, a floating ring or a bulky cape.
Accepted247 front crossing and joins remain protected.
Author-reviewed source/export/browser evidence covers the affected hair/cloth/top boundaries.
runtime: Preauthored component selection from existing build/hair/headwear/top choices. No added profile bits or runtime cloth physics proposed.
